name: reasoning_benchmarks_repeated
description: A collection of established reasoning tasks presented with repeated trials to measure consistency, robustness, and reliability of model reasoning across runs. It aggregates multiple reasoning-style prompts and records performance variation under repeated sampling or slight perturbations. Useful for studying stability of model answers and failure modes in stepwise or multi-step reasoning.
reputation: A research-oriented dataset used by the community studying reasoning robustness and repeatability; modest adoption within that niche.
